about_the_game:
NATO vs. the Warsaw Pact in an alternate future. Slowing down, and coordinating with your team is key in this Rainbow 6 Siege inspired tactical FPS. Red Vanguard: Siege takes the realism and teamwork up another notch, and puts an alternate universe spin on it.

-- THIS GAME IS VERY MUCH A WORK IN PROGRESS --

content_descriptors.notes: It's a multiplayer shooter, currently there isn't really violence, but I plan on leaning into a gritty and realistic theme in the future. If blood, people being shot, blown up, or turned to mist isn't your thing, I wouldn't stick around.

short_description: A Realistic First-Person, 6v6 Tactical Shooter. In an alternate universe where the Soviet Union never fell apart, it looks like the two modern superpowers are starting to get along. Behind the scenes however, the best operatives that NATO and the Warsaw Pact have to offer are going head to head.
